intro: I fix dents without paint or filler, and I do every estimate and repair myself. Door dings, creases and hail damage, worked out from behind the panel so your factory paint stays.

mobile.title: Door dings, at your door.
mobile.intro: For door dings and small dents, I come to you. Hail, deer hits and larger dents are repaired at my Spring Branch shop.

servicesIntro: From a single door ding to a full hail storm.

services.name: Paintless Dent Repair
services.text: Dents pushed out from behind the panel with no sanding, filler or paint. Dents up to 1 inch start at $150.

services.name: Auto Hail Repair
services.text: Complete inspection and repair of hail dents on the roof, hood and trunk, done at my shop.

services.name: Mobile Dent Repair
services.text: Door dings and small dents fixed paintless, same day, where you are.

services.name: Hail Insurance Claims
services.text: You file the claim. I handle the estimate, the adjuster and any supplements.

services.name: Aluminum Panels
services.text: Different tools and technique than steel, and work I do regularly.

why.name: Straight answers
why.text: I tell you what can and can't be fixed before any work starts.

why.name: Exact price first
why.text: You get the exact price before I begin.

why.name: Fully insured
why.text: General liability and garagekeepers coverage, with a satisfaction guarantee.

howTitle: Back to like new, step by step.

steps.name: Send the details
steps.text: Call or text, or upload two photos of your dent for an estimate.

steps.name: Get a straight answer
steps.text: I look at the dent under the light and tell you if paintless repair will work, and the exact price.

steps.name: Drive it smooth
steps.text: I work the dents out, check every panel under the light and hand the car back.
